identity.title: CIRCLE OF TRUTH
identity.tagline: When peace starts dancing it is bliss. In the silence we will sing.
identity.logline: A ceremonial, conversation-led documentary experience exploring regeneration of land, body and spirit through live human encounters, ancestral knowledge, healing arts, collective action and a closing Circle of Truth.
identity.positioning: The original documentary flagship; preserve distinctly from the newer fictional animated companion series.
identity.hostDeckDescription: Funny, charismatic and empathetic medicine man from Romania; host guiding guests through three ceremonial days
identity.world: Regeneration of land, body and spirit

format.runtimeAmbiguity: Original deck says 15 episodes | 90 minutes; verify whether 90 minutes is per episode or a total special before producing published specifications.
format.closingFormat: Circle of Truth discussion with 12 people

pillars.title: Healing arts & embodied practice
pillars.detail: Traditional and modern healing modalities, including sound, movement, herbal traditions and encounters with practitioners

pillars.title: Regeneration & collective action
pillars.detail: Regenerative farming, soil, community stewardship, land restoration and collaborative projects with practical results

pillars.title: Disagreement into understanding
pillars.detail: Live real-time conversation with public figures, healers and everyday people; agree to disagree while seeking common humanity

pillars.title: Ceremony, creativity & music
pillars.detail: Songs, dance, art, story, silence, performance and ritual expression as part of the cultural format

pillars.title: Ancient wisdom meets new systems
pillars.detail: AI ethics, regenerative technology, alternative futures and the distinction drawn in the deck between artificial and divine intelligence

pillars.title: Community partnerships & impact
pillars.detail: Profiles of regenerative projects, partner participation, education and locally grounded collaboration

acts.title: Ancient Future
acts.subtitle: Remembering Our Native Roots
acts.description: The historical and cultural context of ceremonial, ritual and sacramental practices, viewed through the lived knowledge of today's practitioners.

acts.title: All of Our Relations
acts.subtitle: Love, respect & belonging
acts.description: Honoring ancestors and relations, exploring authentic family dynamics and the choices that bring people closer in an isolated world.

acts.title: Regeneration & Collaboration
acts.subtitle: From vision to collective action
acts.description: Regenerative experts build an actionable direction to restore ourselves, one another and the earth through practical stewardship.

acts.title: Sacred Rebellion
acts.subtitle: The courage to question
acts.description: Revisit the role of disruptors, agitators and visionary community builders who pursue a future of love and compassion.

acts.title: Quantum Reality
acts.subtitle: Ancient meets emergent
acts.description: Explore the deck's proposed dialogue between ancient practices, contemporary thinking and solutions for collective futures.

acts.title: Honoring the Divine Masculine & Feminine
acts.subtitle: Relationship as conscious practice
acts.description: Examine partnership, union, gendered archetypes and the diverse stories people use to understand intimacy and personal growth.

acts.title: Our Bodies, Our Sacred Temple
acts.subtitle: Presence in the living body
acts.description: An exploration of practices rooted in caring for the body, movement and embodiment. Claims about efficacy require separate evidence.

acts.title: AI & the Ethics of Illusion
acts.subtitle: Technology, agency & perception
acts.description: A proposed conversation about Artificial Intelligence, the deck's Divine Intelligence framing, illusion and tools for regeneratively minded systems.
